data.name: Mail_account-deleted_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
as you confirmed, your myLife account and vault have been deleted for good.

data.name: Mail_account-deleted_subject
data.value: Your myLife account has been deleted

data.name: Mail_account-locked_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
an administrator has locked your myLife account. You cannot sign in for now. Your data remains unchanged and encrypted.
If you do not know why, please contact the administrator.

data.name: Mail_account-locked_subject
data.value: Your myLife account has been locked

data.name: Mail_account-unlocked_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
an administrator has unlocked your myLife account. You can sign in again.

data.name: Mail_account-unlocked_subject
data.value: Your myLife account has been unlocked

data.name: Mail_deletion-request_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
an administrator has requested to delete your myLife account. This deletes your vault with all entries and documents for good.
Only if you agree, open this link and confirm there: {link}
The link is valid for {days} days. If you do nothing, your account remains.

data.name: Mail_deletion-request_subject
data.value: Please confirm: delete myLife account

data.name: Mail_footer
data.value: This message was sent automatically by myLife ({instance}).

data.name: Mail_invitation-accepted_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
{invitee} has accepted your invitation and created a myLife account.
Sign in to myLife. Your browser then automatically checks that {invitee}'s key really belongs to your invitation.

data.name: Mail_invitation-accepted_subject
data.value: {invitee} has accepted your invitation

data.name: Mail_invitation_body
data.value:
Hello,
{inviter} invites you to myLife, the family's digital emergency folder. In it you record what your relatives need to know in an emergency, encrypted and readable only by you until you share something.
Open this link to set up your account: {link}
The link is valid for {days} days. You need about ten minutes, a printer or pen and paper, and an authenticator app on your phone.
If you do not know {inviter}, simply ignore this email.

data.name: Mail_invitation_subject
data.value: {inviter} invites you to myLife

data.name: Mail_lifesign-due_body
Mail_lifesign-due_subject
data.value: myLife: Please confirm you are well

data.name: Mail_lifesign-reminder_body
Mail_lifesign-reminder_subject
data.value: myLife: Reminder {stage} of {count} – please confirm you are well

data.name: Mail_mode_death
data.value: deceased

data.name: Mail_mode_incapacity
data.value: incapacitated

data.name: Mail_release-revoked_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
{owner} has checked back in on myLife and revoked the release of emergency access. What is meant only for an emergency is no longer visible to you.

data.name: Mail_release-revoked_subject
data.value: myLife: {owner} has revoked emergency access

data.name: Mail_released-owner_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
your emergency access on myLife has been released ({mode}). Your trusted persons can now read what you shared with them for this case.
If this is a mistake, sign in to myLife.

data.name: Mail_released-owner_subject
data.value: myLife: Your emergency access has been released

data.name: Mail_released-trustee_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
{owner}'s emergency access has been released ({mode}). Sign in to myLife; under "Shared with me" you will find what {owner} left for you.

data.name: Mail_released-trustee_subject
data.value: myLife: Access to {owner} released

data.name: Mail_reminder_body
Mail_reminder_dates
data.value: An expiry date or a follow-up is coming up.

data.name: Mail_reminder_review
data.value: {count} areas have not been reviewed for more than {months} months.

data.name: Mail_reminder_subject
data.value: myLife: Time to look at your emergency folder

data.name: Mail_request-info_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
{trustee} has requested access to {owner} on myLife, for the case "{mode}". {owner} can object. You do not need to do anything; if in doubt, talk to {trustee} or {owner}.

data.name: Mail_request-info_subject
data.value: myLife: Access request for {owner}

data.name: Mail_request-objected_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
{owner} has objected to {trustee}'s access request for good. Nothing will be released.

data.name: Mail_request-objected_subject
data.value: myLife: {owner} has objected to the request

data.name: Mail_request-owner_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
{trustee} has requested access to your data on myLife, for the case "{mode}". Without an objection, access will be released on {date}.
If this is not what you want, open this link right away. It pauses the request: {link}
Then sign in and decide whether to object for good. Your other trusted persons have been informed about the request.

data.name: Mail_request-owner_subject
data.value: myLife: {trustee} has requested access

data.name: Mail_request-paused_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
{owner} has paused your access request. The waiting period does not continue for now.

data.name: Mail_request-paused_subject
data.value: myLife: Your request has been paused

data.name: Mail_test_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
this test message shows that myLife can send emails.

data.name: Mail_test_subject
data.value: myLife: test message

data.name: Mail_trustee-added_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
{owner} has named you as a trusted person on myLife. What you may see in an emergency stays encrypted until it is released. If {owner} already shares something with you today, you will find it under "Shared with me" after signing in.

data.name: Mail_trustee-added_subject
data.value: {owner} has named you as a trusted person

data.name: Mail_twofactor-reset_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
an administrator has reset the two-factor sign-in of your myLife account. The authenticator app and passkeys have been removed. At your next sign-in, after the master password, you set up an authenticator app again.
If you did not ask for this, please contact the administrator immediately.

data.name: Mail_twofactor-reset_subject
data.value: myLife: two-factor sign-in reset

data.name: Mail_vault-deleted_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
as agreed by all trusted persons, {owner}'s vault on myLife has now been deleted for good.

data.name: Mail_vault-deleted_subject
data.value: myLife: {owner}'s vault deleted

data.name: Mail_vault-deletion-cancelled_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
{trustee} has withdrawn their agreement. {owner}'s vault will not be deleted for now.

data.name: Mail_vault-deletion-cancelled_subject
data.value: myLife: Deletion of {owner}'s vault cancelled

data.name: Mail_vault-deletion-proposed_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
{trustee} suggests deleting {owner}'s vault on myLife for good. It will only be deleted if all trusted persons agree. Sign in and decide under "Emergency access". Save anything you want to keep first.

data.name: Mail_vault-deletion-proposed_subject
data.value: myLife: Delete {owner}'s vault?

data.name: Mail_vault-deletion-scheduled-owner_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
your trusted persons have agreed to delete your vault on myLife for good on {date}. If this is a mistake, sign in right away and revoke the release under "Emergency access"; then nothing will be deleted.

data.name: Mail_vault-deletion-scheduled-owner_subject
data.value: myLife: Your vault will be deleted on {date}

data.name: Mail_vault-deletion-scheduled_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
all trusted persons have agreed: {owner}'s vault will be deleted for good on {date}. Until then you can withdraw your agreement under "Emergency access".

data.name: Mail_vault-deletion-scheduled_subject
data.value: myLife: {owner}'s vault will be deleted on {date}
